analysis.title: Independent Power Producers: Sparks & Quarks - SpaceX Commentary Reinforces Power Demand Fundamentals; XE Inks 1GW JDA with AEP and AMZN; IPPs Lag
key_insights: SPCX commentary on its 3Q26 earnings call lifted the power complex on Wednesday. Management discussed a 'blue sky' scenario of adding 20GW of incremental power and cooling next year, with high confidence in at least 10GW.
JPM sees power names benefiting broadly but IPPs as best positioned given existing near-term supply. The comments reinforce the speed and scale of demand against a weaker AI sentiment backdrop.
JPM's trading desk saw supply in CEG ahead of the session, with investors reducing exposure after contracting wins, in JPM's view.

IPPs (-3.5%) underperformed Utilities (+0.3%) and the S&P 500 (-0.1%) over the past week. CEG -7.4% 1W and -26.4% YTD, NRG -3.0% 1W and -38.0% YTD, TLN -2.5% 1W and -6.8% YTD, VST -1.0% 1W and -6.4% YTD.

CEG completed the sale of the Brazos Valley Energy Center (606MW ERCOT gas combined cycle) to LS Power for $860mm, about $1,420/kW. It is CEG's last required divestiture following the Calpine acquisition.

X-energy (XE), AEP and Amazon signed a Joint Development Agreement to study a 960MW, 12-unit Xe-100 SMR plant in Sullivan County, Indiana, at AEP's retired Breed coal plant site. Amazon would fund project development and buy the power under a long-term contract.

JPM calls the XE JDA an encouraging signal that follows 2Q call commentary pointing to a 1GW announcement by year-end. Details on firm offtake, financing, capex and licensing timeline could build investor confidence.

AtkinsRéalis signed an MoU with Hoosier Energy and the state of Indiana to explore a campus of up to eight CANDU reactors (up to 6GW), likely worth about $12-24B. JPM sees it as proof of new-build upside and reiterates Overweight on ATRL.

The Nuclear Company proposed Prosperity One, a 6.6GW nuclear campus in Lewis County, Kentucky, with construction planned for 2028. It is at an early stage with only the site identified and needs NRC license approval.

AEP plans about $4bn for a 702MW Bloom Energy fuel-cell facility near Cheyenne, Wyoming, under a 20-year PPA with Google. It is about 92% owned by AEP, with construction starting in 2026 and full operation by year-end 2028.
AEP signed to buy up to 1.6GW of Mainspring Energy linear generators (first 190MW in 2027, option for 200MW a year through 2034), a deal worth over $4bn.
Venture Global will build on-site gas-fired generation for data centers, with GE Vernova and Baker Hughes supplying equipment. Projects come online in late 2028 and are off-grid.

PJM approved three projects totaling about 2.1GW through its Expedited Interconnection Track (Engie storage of 860MW in PA and 800MW in OH, and a 455MW Hunterstown uprate), all expected online by mid 2029.

Forward ATC power prices fell across the board over the past week. YTD, PJM West and East 2027 ATC are about $6/MWh higher and ERCOT North and West 2027 are about $8/MWh lower. 2028 forwards are about $10/MWh higher in PJM and $3-4/MWh lower in ERCOT.
JPM rates CEG, TLN and VST Overweight with price targets of $385, $440 and $231 against prices of $258.84, $349.43 and $150.32. NRG is not covered.

market_movers.rationale: Price target implies 49.4% total return from $258.84. Stock fell 7.4% on the week amid desk-observed supply after contracting wins.
Price target implies 25.9% total return from $349.43. Stock is 78% of its 52-week high.
Price target implies 54.3% total return from $150.32.
Indiana CANDU MoU for up to 6GW, likely worth about $12-24B, is another proof point of new-build upside.
Nuclear new-build announcements (XE, ATRL, The Nuclear Company) support the sector.

sector_views.rationale: Existing near-term supply makes IPPs best positioned for accelerating data center power demand.
Multiple new-build announcements in Indiana and Kentucky point to a multi-billion dollar U.S. opportunity.
